criteria.notes: Published map package, visitor directory, destination details, routes, floor controls, and media match the approved runtime scope.
The Northline campus concept retains its authored map geometry, destination hierarchy, branding, and source-specific spatial composition.
The runtime reads as a purpose-built spatial product with map-first composition, restrained directory controls, and destination-specific details.
Primary destination names, active route, floor label, and directory controls remain legible at both Full HD and compact signage sizes.
Light and dark presets preserve readable controls, route contrast, selected-location emphasis, and detail-panel hierarchy.
Long translated destination names and descriptions stay bounded through wrapping, clamping, and the intentional directory scroll region.
The map remains dominant while directory, filters, destination details, and route actions stay organized without overlap or clipped controls.
Brand, symbol, and photo assets render from the packaged artifact; theme colors and selection treatments remain coherent in both views.
The spatial canvas, 2D and 3D representations, semantic map layers, and visitor directory are distinct from the repository's dashboard examples.

screenshots.notes: Full HD 3D runtime is nonblank, correctly framed, and shows the directory, route, selected destination, details, and packaged media.
Compact runtime keeps the map usable and all controls bounded; the destination list scrolls intentionally without obscuring details.
Default scenario reproduces the complete visitor flow with map, route, destination selection, controls, and detail content.
Compact scenario preserves responsive structure, readable controls, and correct selected-location emphasis without overlap.
Dark scenario maintains sufficient foreground, route, control, and selected-area contrast across the compact surface.
Flat-map scenario hides 3D extrusion while retaining the background map, semantic selection, route, media, and destination details.
